data.case_title: Hunting license application rejected – insurance proof expired
data.title: Rejection of hunting license application (Jagdschein)

sender.name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen – Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd

data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen (hunting authority) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because the submitted proof of hunting liability insurance expired on 30 June 2026. The license will be issued without a new application once valid proof of insurance is submitted.
data.explanation: The hunting authority (Waffenbehörde) could not issue your hunting license because your insurance proof had already expired. You don't need to file a new application — just send them a current confirmation of hunting liability insurance and they will issue the license. You also have the right to formally object (Widerspruch) to this rejection if you disagree with it; the app shows until when you can do so. If you neither submit new insurance proof nor object, the rejection stands and no license will be issued.

items.title: Submit a current hunting liability insurance confirmation
items.action: Send the authority a valid, current confirmation of hunting liability insurance (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung) so the license can be issued without filing a new application.
items.consequence: Without valid insurance proof, the hunting license cannot be issued.
